escapeSemantics: result.json escapedBugs = held-out failures at declared-done and heldoutPassed = passes (run-pair.sh extract_metrics; a non-compiling final state counts as ALL tests failing), and taskSuccess is escapedBugs == 0. PP-W-rows does NOT read escapedBugs as its leg-A escape: ESCAPE = at least one of tests.effectObservingTests failed on a workspace that BUILT. A run whose declared-done state does not build — the shape arm B's shortcut takes, and any budget exhaustion — is NOT an escape; it is published as its own category (non-building declared-done), because scoring it as up to heldoutTestCount escapes would invert leg A's sign against the arm whose compiler refuses the laundering.

parity.notes: Both arms are Calor; the starters differ only by effect rows (before/ vs after/). Not a C#-vs-Calor pair; the gates-doc §3.3 decl/complexity parity is trivially equal.

shapeRealizedIndicator.name: field-stored stage
shapeRealizedIndicator.question: the final source declares a function-typed §FLD in RetryBehavior and Twice passes it to RunTwice
shapeRealizedIndicator.reportedBy: ppw-analyze.py, per cell, beside the escape rate
shapeRealizedIndicator.why: On arm A the natural spellings of this shape are pushed away — a printing §LAM inside a §CTOR is error Calor0422 on BOTH arms, and a bare module-level method group is Calor1002 (#1118) — so an agent reaching for the natural spelling lands on the W-001s lambda shape, which arm A WARNS about, silently degrading a blind cell to warning-vs-error at run time. Without this indicator a null leg A cannot be told apart from a cell that was never realized. Recorded, never scored: it gates no run.
